Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.internal.find

Class NonImageObjectConverter

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.internal.find.NonImageObjectConverter
@Component public class NonImageObjectConverter extends Object
Converts non-image state objects into Match objects for action processing.

This component handles the conversion of various non-image elements (regions, locations, and existing matches) from ObjectCollections into Match objects. Unlike image-based finding which requires pattern matching, these objects are directly converted since their positions are already known.

Non-image objects include:

  • StateRegion - Predefined regions on screen
  • StateLocation - Specific screen coordinates
  • Existing Match objects from previous operations

  • Method Details

    • getOtherObjectsDirectlyAsMatchObjects

      public ActionResult getOtherObjectsDirectlyAsMatchObjects(ObjectCollection objectCollection)
      Converts all non-image objects from an ObjectCollection into Match objects.

      This method processes regions, locations, and existing matches from the collection, converting each into appropriate Match objects and aggregating them into a single ActionResult.

      Parameters:
      objectCollection - The collection containing non-image objects to convert
      Returns:
      An ActionResult containing Match objects created from all non-image elements in the collection

    • addMatches

      public void addMatches(ActionResult matches, ObjectCollection objectCollection)
      Adds existing matches from the ObjectCollection to the ActionResult.

      This method transfers all pre-existing match results from the collection to the provided ActionResult. The matches parameter is modified by adding all results from the ObjectCollection's matches.

      Parameters:
      matches - The ActionResult to which matches will be added. This object is modified by the method.
      objectCollection - The source collection containing existing matches

    • addRegions

      public void addRegions(ActionResult matches, ObjectCollection objectCollection)
      Converts StateRegions from the ObjectCollection into Match objects.

      Each StateRegion is transformed into a Match object that preserves the region's boundaries, anchor points, and associated state data. Note that text finding within regions is handled separately and not part of this conversion process.

      Parameters:
      matches - The ActionResult to which region-based matches will be added. This object is modified by the method.
      objectCollection - The source collection containing StateRegions to convert

    • addLocations

      public void addLocations(ActionResult matches, ObjectCollection objectCollection)
      Converts StateLocations from the ObjectCollection into Match objects.

      Each StateLocation represents a specific point on screen and is converted into a Match object centered at that location. The original state data is preserved in the resulting Match.

      Parameters:
      matches - The ActionResult to which location-based matches will be added. This object is modified by the method.
      objectCollection - The source collection containing StateLocations to convert
